utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — what time should I bring the tools?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Around 3 would be great, if that still works for you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, 3 works for me — I’ll bring the tools then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the exact drop-off time and who’s handling pickup so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, that makes sense. Can you confirm the drop-off time and who’ll be picking it up?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d say we should set a firm drop-off time first, and then I can let you know who’s on pickup once that’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I think I saw something about it... what’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, quite a bit—I'm pretty sure we’ve got a few more things to fix up now, though I’d have to check the list again. Want me to go have a look?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, if you could check the list, that’d be great. I might’ve missed the updates.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can spread the word about the repair drive. I’ll mention it to a few neighbors today.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — that’d really help a lot. I appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll talk to a few people today and make sure they know about it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds like I’m late as usual—what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: A few things are still open—mostly that loose fence panel and the leaky hose bib. If you’ve got a few minutes, I can point you to the tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can handle the fence panel first—point me to the tools and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what time is the repair drive, and where should I bring the items?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It starts at 10 a.m. over at the community center parking lot—just bring whatever you’ve got, and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, I’ll be there at 10 a.m. at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sam, do you already know which repairs are highest priority for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Not yet, but I can help sort them out—usually the biggest safety issues and anything keeping folks from using their homes come first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—can you help me list the top safety repairs first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I can help spread the word and see who’s able to pitch in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — that’d be a big help. If you hear back from anyone, just let me know who can make it and when.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and send you names and times as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you help me make a simple sign-up list and check in with a few neighbors about what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can make a simple sign-up list and check in with a few neighbors about what needs fixing. I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a little list going—tools, tape, and a few extra bulbs so far. If you think of anything else for the repair drive, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—maybe add some batteries and a screwdriver set if you’ve got room.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good call—I’ll add batteries and a screwdriver set to the list. Thanks, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are bringing all sorts of tools and spare parts—looks like it might actually help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, sounds promising. I might stop by and see if they still need anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great—if you’ve got extra screws, tape, or even old hand tools, they’d probably take them. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear they need something specific.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help, but could you remind me what details we’ve confirmed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — we’re aiming for Saturday morning at the community center parking lot, and I’m still finalizing who’s bringing tools and supplies. I’ll send you the full list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. I’ll wait for the full list before I commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just point me to what needs fixing and I’ll skim the rest.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks—I've got a few spots to check on, and I’ll point out the main ones first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—just give me the main spots and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks about it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate that. It’ll help a lot if people keep it on their radar.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll keep mentioning it to folks around the block and make sure they don’t forget.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. If you could bring some sturdy tape and a few clean rags, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can grab some sturdy tape and a few clean rags. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard about the repair drive. What do you need me to know?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly just bring whatever skills or tools you’ve got, and I can help match folks up with jobs. If you’ve got a drill or wrench to lend, that’d be a big help too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring my wrench and a screwdriver set. Tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal, I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive rolling. I can help organize the sign-ups and keep track of what each neighbor needs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be a huge help, Rosa—if you can keep a list of who needs what and where they’re located, I can make sure nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ll start a clear list with names, needed repairs, and addresses, then share it with you as it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d want to know the exact drop-off time and what needs hauling first. It’s easier if we pin down the logistics before we promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — let’s lock that down. I’ll check the exact drop-off time and make a quick list of what needs hauling first, then I’ll send it your way.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that works for me. Send me the time and the hauling list, and I’ll see what I can fit in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check the details before I say for sure, but I think it is still happening today.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks—can you confirm the time and place too?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me—what time are we heading out for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m probably running a bit late, but I can meet you there around 6.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, 6 works for me. I’ll head over then and wait for you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard about the repair drive from a couple neighbors—sounds really helpful. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell — we could really use any spare tools, screws, or batteries you’ve got. Even a quick donation or helping sort supplies would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can bring over some spare screws and batteries later today, and I’m happy to help sort supplies too. Just let me know when and where to come by.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Mara, I’m still up for the repair drive—just point me where to help and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Oren—thanks. Could you help sort the tools by the community shed, then we’ll see where else you’re needed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I’ll head to the community shed and start sorting the tools now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I need to make sure it doesn’t clash with school drop-off or pickup. What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: How about late morning, around 10:30? That should avoid drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work for me, as long as it stays on schedule. I can help around 10:30.
